behaviors.description: Report minimum-free-space query failure and recovery when installation storage is unavailable.
behaviors.preconditions: Fresh private user installation; its whole public location can be moved and restored.
behaviors.expected: Initial query succeeds and writes its result; replacing installation directory with a file causes false plus an error; restoring the directory recovers the original value.

mappings.rationale: Public getter distinguishes available, unavailable and restored storage. This does not establish interpretation of custom repository configuration.

surface_assertions.rationale: Success writes a value, unavailable public installation storage produces an error, and restoration recovers the initial result.

notes: The whole location returned by get_path is moved; no private repository paths or configuration files are accessed.
